pdpa.notice_body: ResearchLink Malaysia collects and processes your personal data (email, university, faculty, year of study) to operate the academic survey exchange platform. Your data is processed under the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) 2010 (Amendment 2024). You have the right to access, correct, transfer, and delete your data at any time.
pdpa.dpo_contact: Contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO): dpo@researchlink.my
pdpa.anonymised_note: Respondent data is never revealed to researchers. Only aggregated, non-personally-identifiable information is shared.
